11646.name: Jalen Coker
11646.reason: Missed Wk4 vs DET. Canales said a hamstring injury kept him out, on top of the quad strain from Wk3. CAR has its bye in Wk5 and Canales is 'hopeful' he returns Wk6 vs PHI. Two soft-tissue issues, so Wk6 is a lean-play game-time risk.
11646.source: Yahoo Sports/QC News 2026-10-05 (Canales hopeful for Wk6, hamstring + quad); NBC Sports 2026-10-04 (Schefter: unlikely Wk4)

5850.name: Josh Jacobs
5850.reason: Still on commissioner's exempt list as of Wk5 injury report; no new ruling or timeline. Rapoport earlier said return not imminent, possibly after 5-8 games 'time served'. Window kept; return discounted for Kaleb Johnson's role.
5850.source: DraftKings Network 2026-10-06 (still on Exempt List); Rapoport via Acme Packing Co (Sept 2026, 5-8 games)

4892.name: Baker Mayfield
4892.reason: Dislocated right thumb (Wk3). Did not practice Mon/Tue and will miss TNF Wk5 vs DAL. Timeline is 3-6 weeks depending on when he can grip the ball. Wk6 vs PIT is the more likely return per NBC, but it could slip.
4892.source: NBC Sports/Rotoworld 2026-10-05 (DNP, out Thursday, Wk6 likelier return, 3-6 wks); DraftKings Network 2026-10-06 (DNP Tuesday); ESPN (return hinges on grip)

8136.name: Rachaad White
8136.reason: Shoulder injury: no practice all of last week and ruled out of Wk4 vs IND. Quinn says he 'should' practice this week, so questionable for Wk5 vs NYG. Ekeler and Croskey-Merritt cut into his role.
8136.source: RotoWire 2026-10-05 (Quinn via Washington Post, should practice); NBC Sports 2026-10-02 (ruled out Wk4)

8142.name: Alec Pierce
8142.reason: On IR with an aggravated heel injury; eligible Wk7 but no guarantee he's ready then. Rehabbing without surgery (surgery still possible) and there's no timeline. Conservative window.
8142.source: Pro Football Network IR update 2026-10-06; DraftKings Network 2026-10-06 (no surgery, continuing rehab)

13296.name: Caleb Douglas
13296.reason: Ankle injury; has missed 2 straight games and hasn't practiced since. Hafley: day-to-day, 'one day at a time'. Likely needs a full practice to play Wk5 vs CIN, and MIA may stay cautious with its Wk6 bye coming.
13296.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-05 (Hafley 'one day at a time'); WFLX 2026-10-02 (ruled out Wk4)

13286.name: Jadarian Price
13286.reason: Placed on IR Oct 3 after re-aggravating a Wk2 chest injury in practice. Must miss Wks 4-7, earliest return Wk8. Charbonnet's return threatens his share.

12469.name: Dylan Sampson
12469.reason: Still on IR (knee sprain from Wk1), eligible to return Wk6. No new practice or return news, and earlier reports said 'significant time', so Wk6 isn't assumed.
12469.source: DraftKings Network 2026-10-06 (still on IR); NBC Sports 2026-09-15 (IR)

11583.name: Jonathon Brooks
11583.reason: On IR after core-muscle surgery Sept 23; Canales said 6-8 weeks. Earliest realistic return is about Wk9-10. Low-priority stash; CAR bye is Wk5.
11583.source: Pro Football Network IR update 2026-10-06; RotoBaller (Canales 6-8 weeks)

11566.name: Jayden Daniels
11566.reason: Dislocated left (non-throwing) elbow in Wk2; missed Wks 3-4. Quinn says the goal is a full practice week and a start, and Garafolo reports he's expected to start Wk5 vs NYG. Small discount for the brace and fewer designed runs.
11566.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-06 (Garafolo: expected to start Wk5); DraftKings Network 2026-10-06 (Quinn aiming for full week)

9753.name: Zach Charbonnet
9753.reason: PUP practice window opened Oct 1 (limited practice twice). Macdonald says he won't be activated for Wk5 vs SF. Debut expected Wk6-7, then a ramp-up while sharing with Wilson/Holani.
9753.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-05 (Macdonald: won't play Wk5); Pro Football Network 2026-10-06 (debut Wk6-7)

5022.name: Dallas Goedert
5022.reason: MCL sprain in Wk2; has missed Wks 3-4 without practicing and was expected to miss 3-4 weeks. Reported Oct 6 as likely to miss a third game (Wk5 in London vs JAX). Wk6 return plausible.
5022.source: NBC Sports Philadelphia 2026-10-06 ('could miss a third in Week 5'); The Liberty Line 2026-10-06 (3-4 weeks)

8155.name: Breece Hall
8155.reason: Quad/thigh injury from Wk3; didn't practice at all last week and missed Wk4. Week-to-week, not on IR. Questionable at best for Wk5 vs CLE until practice reports come out.
8155.source: RotoBaller 2026-10-06 (week-to-week, missed Wk4); DraftKings Network 2026-10-06; NBC Sports 2026-10-02 (ruled out Wk4)

7543.name: Travis Etienne
7543.reason: Placed on IR (hamstring) Oct 1; must miss at least 4 games. Earliest return is Wk9 (Nov 8 vs CLE) after the Wk8 bye. Kamara leads the backfield meanwhile.
7543.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-01 (placed on IR); theScore/Yahoo (next chance Nov 8 vs CLE); Pro Football Network 2026-10-06

6794.name: Justin Jefferson
6794.reason: Ankle sprain from Wk3; sat out Wk4 vs MIA and hadn't practiced or been cleared. O'Connell unsure about Wk5 vs NO but says 'great progress'. Fowler says MIN is hopeful and it's not long-term. MIN bye Wk6.
6794.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-04 (KOC unsure for Wk5); NBC Sports 2026-10-03 (Fowler: could play Wk5); DraftKings Network 2026-10-06 (not cleared)

7021.name: Rico Dowdle
7021.reason: Missed Wk4 with dislocated toe; McCarthy says he had a positive workout and is 'making progress', Rapoport gives him a 'pretty good chance' to play Wk5 vs IND but team not certain. Once back McCarthy expects a one-two punch with Jaylen Warren (220 yds on 34 carries the last two weeks), so a committee discount applies all season.
7021.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-05 (McCarthy 'making progress', committee with Warren); NBC Sports 2026-10-01 (Rapoport 'pretty good chance' Wk5); DK Network 2026-10-06 (status TBD)

5859.name: A.J. Brown
5859.reason: High-ankle sprain Wk1, on IR (eligible Wk6). Garafolo says the 'hope' is Week 6 but that is ambitious; Rapoport's timeline points to ~Wk8; he was seen walking without a limp Monday. Out Wk5-6, discounted Wk7-8 for return uncertainty.
5859.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-04 (Garafolo: hope is Wk6); DK Network 2026-10-06 (~Week 8, walking without limp per CLNS)

7611.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
7611.reason: Healthy, no injury. Role improved: out-snapped Henderson 50-28 (66% vs 37%) in the Wk4 win over BUF, so the timeshare discount drops from 0.85 to 0.9.
7611.source: Boston Globe 2026-10-06 (Patriots-Bills snap counts); Pats Pulpit 2026-10-05 (Wk4 snap counts)

13287.name: Jeremiyah Love
13287.reason: Tweaked his other ankle in the Wk4 loss to NYG (separate from the August high-ankle sprain) and gave way to Allgeier late. LaFleur calls it a 'management-type thing'; Wk5 status vs DET to be clarified at Wednesday practice.
13287.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-05 (LaFleur: tweaked other ankle); DK Network 2026-10-06 (ankle, TBD)

4035.name: Alvin Kamara
4035.reason: Knee injury on MNF Wk4 vs ATL required two medical-tent trips but he returned and scored a 4th-quarter TD; described as relatively minor and he is expected to keep leading the backfield with Etienne on IR. No official diagnosis yet and he had a right MCL sprain in August, so a modest Wk5 discount.
4035.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-06 (returned, injury relatively minor); Yahoo Sports 2026-10-06 (injury details, no severity update yet)

10229.name: Rashee Rice
10229.reason: Hamstring injury in Wk4 vs LV, did not return. Reid called it a 'tweak' and NFL Network called it minor, but The Athletic's Mike Silver says he could miss several weeks. KC has its bye Wk5; Wk6 vs LAC is uncertain.
10229.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-04 (Silver: could miss several weeks); CBS Sports 2026-10-05 (minor tweak, may not miss time)

12534.name: Kyle Monangai
12534.reason: Hurt right thumb late in the Wk4 win over NYJ (30-146-2). Ben Johnson calls it day-to-day and says 'we think he's going to be OK'; imaging was not concerning. Expected to play Wk5 vs GB.
12534.source: Chicago Sun-Times 2026-10-05 (not considered serious); DK Network 2026-10-06 (day-to-day per Johnson)

4881.name: Lamar Jackson
4881.reason: Sprained ankle in Wk4 vs TEN, left in a walking boot. Rapoport says a 'rarer type of ankle sprain' makes him unlikely for Wk5 vs ATL and he could miss multiple games; Minter says not 'crazy long-term'. Tyler Huntley expected to start Wk5.
4881.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-06 (Rapoport: outside chance Wk5, could miss multiple weeks); DK Network 2026-10-06 (unlikely Wk5, Huntley trending to start)

5927.name: Terry McLaurin
5927.reason: Hurt hamstring in Friday practice before Wk4 and was inactive in London despite pushing to play. Quinn will update after Wednesday practice; Wk5 vs NYG is a genuine coin flip. Bye is Wk7.
5927.source: DK Network 2026-10-06 (Quinn assessing at Wednesday practice); Fox Sports 2026-10-04 (inactive vs IND)

11635.name: Ladd McConkey
11635.reason: Re-aggravated a recurring foot injury in Wk4 vs SEA (24 snaps, 0 catches). Harbaugh first said week-to-week, then on Tuesday upgraded him to day-to-day; not guaranteed for Wk5 at DEN.
11635.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-06 (Harbaugh: day to day); Rotowire 2026-10-05 (initially week-to-week)

7564.name: Ja'Marr Chase
7564.reason: Concussion in Wk4 vs JAX after a facemask tackle; in protocol and called day-to-day by Zac Taylor, with Wednesday the next checkpoint. Wk5 at MIA is in doubt; Bengals bye is Wk6.
7564.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-05 (Taylor: in protocol); CBS Sports 2026-10-05 (questionable, return unlikely on turnaround); DK Network 2026-10-06 (not yet cleared)

4866.name: Saquon Barkley
4866.reason: Hamstring pulled on his second carry Wk4 vs LAR. Eagles consider him week-to-week but not long-term; unlikely for Wk5 in London vs JAX. Sirianni to give more on Wednesday.
4866.source: DK Network 2026-10-06 (week-to-week, not long-term per Rapoport); BVM Sports 2026-10-05 (week-to-week); NBC Sports 2026-10-05 (Sirianni update Wed)

7525.name: DeVonta Smith
7525.reason: Hamstring kept him out of Wk4. Garafolo says he is questionable 'at very best' for Wk5 in London; reports suggest a multi-week injury with a likely return Wk6 or Wk7.
7525.source: NBC Sports 2026-10-04 (Garafolo: questionable at very best Wk5); DK Network 2026-10-06 (not cleared ahead of London trip)

9225.name: Tank Bigsby
9225.reason: Abdominal injury in Wk4 requires core-muscle surgery; placed on IR Tuesday (out at least 4 games, earliest return Wk9). Rapoport says hope is 'six weeks or shorter', so Wk9 is possible but uncertain (bye Wk10).
9225.source: Rotowire 2026-10-06 (placed on IR); Ian Rapoport/X 2026-10-05 (core muscle surgery, six weeks or shorter); DK Network 2026-10-06

4983.name: DJ Moore
4983.reason: Aggravated the left-shoulder AC joint sprain (first suffered Wk2) in Wk4 vs NE and left in the 2nd quarter. Schefter says it is not a long-term issue 'as of right now', but Wk5 vs LAR is uncertain.
4983.source: ESPN/Adam Schefter 2026-10-04 (aggravated shoulder, not long-term); DK Network 2026-10-06 (status TBD)

6801.name: Tee Higgins
6801.reason: Adductor/groin injury on the final drive of Wk4 vs JAX after 11-157. Taylor calls him day-to-day, not week-to-week, so he has a reasonable chance to play Wk5 at MIA. Bengals bye is Wk6.
6801.source: PrizePicks 2026-10-06 (day-to-day, not week-to-week); DK Network 2026-10-06 (Taylor: day-to-day)
